Hello , {!Fetch_Case_Detaisl.SuppliedName}


Thank you for contacting Iron Mountain Customer Care, your case ID is {!Fetch_Case_Detaisl.CaseNumber}. Your email is important to us and will be assigned to a Customer Care Professional as soon as possible. We will contact you if we have any questions and/or when your request has been completed.
